theme_archetype.description: Premium, elegant dark theme featuring deep obsidian backgrounds with soft gold and blush accents, utilizing glassmorphism and bento grids to deliver a high-end salon aesthetic.

rules.h1: font-playfair text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-medium
rules.h2: font-playfair text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-medium
rules.labels: font-outfit text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-white/60 font-semibold

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8 for cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 for bento grids.
layout_strategy.global_structure: Sidebar on the left (fixed, w-64). Top navigation bar (h-16 or h-20, sticky glassmorphism). Main content area takes remaining space. Use max-h-screen for POS to prevent window scrolling, keep scrolling inside specific panels.
layout_strategy.pos_dashboard: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. Dense but elegant. 3-column layout where Left 2 columns are services bento grid, Right 1 column is the active checkout/cart (sticky).
layout_strategy.borders: Expose the skeleton selectively. 1px borders with border-white/10 to define areas without heaviness.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#F0C847] transition-all duration-300 font-semibold rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 transition-all duration-300 rounded-md px-6 py-2.5
buttons.ghost: text-white/70 hover:text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-all rounded-md px-4 py-2

cards.default: bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-lg
cards.glass: bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]

inputs.default: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-md px-4 py-2.5 text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:border-[#D4AF37] transition-all placeholder:text-white/30

sidebar.active_item: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37]/10 to-transparent border-l-2 border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37]
sidebar.inactive_item: text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 border-l-2 border-transparent transition-all

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-0.5) and glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]) on interactive cards.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (framer-motion: initial={opacity: 0, y: 10} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}).

logo_abstract.description: Abstract Gold Circle (Use as Miracurl brand mark placeholder)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config extending these colors, fonts, and box-shadows. Install @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react.
2. Setup React Router for the main app layout containing the Sidebar and Top Navigation.
3. Implement the Auth screen (Login/Signup/Forgot Password) utilizing a split layout: dark elegant form on one side, and the luxury salon hero interior image on the other.
4. Construct the Dashboard Layout: A dark sidebar (bg-[#0A0A0A]) with gold-accented active states, and a top navigation bar (glassmorphism bg-[#121212]/80 backdrop-blur).

5. For the POS/Billing screen, build a 3-column bento grid layout. Left 2 columns display service/product cards. Right column is the active invoice/cart pane, pinned and sticky. Apply 1px border-white/10 to everything.

6. Build the CRM/Customer Database, Reports, and Inventory screens utilizing Shadcn tables, heavily customized to remove the default Vercel white look. Switch tables to dark mode with pure #0A0A0A backgrounds and hover:bg-[#1A1A1A].
7. Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers).
8. Ensure the hero and image sections DO NOT use full opaque black overlays. Keep them bg-black/40 maximum to let the luxury images shine through.
